questions.q_en: Why optogenetics at all? Is the light control in your system necessary — you could have used constitutive expression instead.
questions.q_zh: 為什麼要用光遺傳學？你們系統裡的光控制真的必要嗎？直接用組成型表現不就好了。
questions.a_en: Because the decision of when to make the protectant belongs in the field, not inside the cell: rice photosynthesis is inhibited above about 25 degrees while sorghum stays optimal to about 32.5, so stress sensing built into the bacterium would have to be re-engineered for every crop we sell into. Light is how a number from our model reaches the cells — nothing is added to the culture, nothing is left in a product sprayed on food, and an LED signals through a sealed vessel without opening the 0.2 micrometre membrane that is our containment. It also separates growth from production, and we checked the trigger is cheap: across six light arms the growth rates ran 0.279 to 0.317 per hour, all within one standard error of each other. We did build constitutive versions of every cargo and they are our controls, not our product, which is how a negative result gets assigned to the protectant rather than to the light system.
questions.a_zh: 因為「什麼時候該做保護蛋白」這個決定屬於田裡，不屬於細胞裡：水稻的光合作用大約 25 度以上就開始受抑制，高粱要到約 32.5 度才離開最適範圍，所以把逆境感測做進菌體裡，等於每換一種作物就要重新改造菌株。光是模型算出來的數字抵達細胞的方式——不必往培養液裡加任何東西、噴在食用作物上的產品不會有殘留，而且 LED 可以在容器密閉的狀態下送訊號，不必打開那層 0.2 微米、也就是我們唯一圍阻的膜。它同時把生長和生產分開，而我們確認過這個觸發本身很便宜：六組光照條件下生長速率落在每小時 0.279 到 0.317 之間，彼此都在一個標準誤以內。我們每一個產物都另外做了組成型版本，那是我們的對照組、不是我們的產品，這樣一個陰性結果才能歸因到保護蛋白本身而不是光反應系統。
questions.trap_en: Saying optogenetics was chosen because it is novel, or implying the switch has been shown to work. The reasons are crop-specific thresholds and a sealed vessel; on the evidence the honest sentence is supported at 13 hours, unresolved at 16 hours, n = 2.
questions.trap_zh: 說選光遺傳學是因為它比較新，或暗示光開關已經證明有效。理由是作物閾值和密閉容器；證據上誠實的說法是「13 小時支持、16 小時未定、n = 2」。
questions.basis: instructor's priority set, 30 Oct read-through of Results, Hardware and Plants

questions.q_en: Why do you think AmilCP failed? The culture never changed colour at all.
questions.q_zh: 你們覺得 AmilCP 為什麼失敗？培養液從頭到尾都沒有變色。
kw_en: beta-barrel folds fast, Sec needs unfolded
kw_zh: β-barrel 折太快，Sec 要未折疊
我們停下來不再做替代指標
questions.a_en: It never coloured anything: the medium stayed colourless and absorbance at 588 nanometres was 0.081 with the construct against 0.082 without, so there is no chromogenic AmilCP in either the medium or the cells. Our explanation is secretion rather than expression — AmilCP is a beta-barrel that folds rapidly in the cytoplasm, and the Bacillus subtilis Sec pathway requires a protein to stay unfolded during translocation, which is a documented bottleneck for heterologous cargo in Bacillus. Rather than repeat it we reasoned to that mechanism, moved to GanA, failed that too, and then abandoned reporters entirely and measured the protectants directly by ELISA and the DNPH assay. Knowing when to stop building a proxy was the engineering result.
questions.a_zh: 它完全沒有顯色：培養液始終無色，588 奈米吸光帶構築是 0.081、不帶是 0.082，所以培養液和菌體裡都沒有會顯色的 AmilCP。我們的解釋是分泌而不是表現——AmilCP 是 β-barrel，在細胞質裡折疊得很快，而 B. subtilis 的 Sec 途徑要求蛋白在轉運過程中保持未折疊，這在 Bacillus 的異源蛋白文獻裡是已知的瓶頸。我們沒有重複做，而是推到這個機制、轉向 GanA、那個也失敗，最後完全放棄報告蛋白，直接用 ELISA 和 DNPH 測保護蛋白本身。知道什麼時候該停止做替代指標，本身就是一個工程結果。
questions.trap_en: Claiming we proved it is a folding problem. We ran no cytoplasmic-versus-secreted comparison, so never made has not been excluded; say our explanation is secretion, not that we showed it.
questions.trap_zh: 說我們證明了這是折疊問題。我們沒有做細胞質內 vs 分泌的對照，所以「根本沒做出來」還沒被排除；要說「我們的解釋是分泌」，不是「我們證明了」。
questions.basis: instructor's priority set, 30 Oct read-through of Results, Hardware and Plants

questions.q_en: Why did you choose these three protectants — ACC deaminase, BoPep4 and LEA14?
questions.q_zh: 你們為什麼選這三個保護蛋白——ACC 去胺酶、BoPep4 和 LEA14？
questions.a_en: Three different mechanisms, so the failure of one is not the failure of the idea. ACC deaminase is a true catalyst: it degrades ACC, the ethylene precursor, before ACC oxidase can make ethylene, so one molecule works many times, which is why every bench result on the wiki was produced with it. LEA14 is stoichiometric, an intrinsically disordered hydrophilin that protects membranes and proteins through dehydration, so the only levers are more copies or more work per copy; BoPep4 is a twenty-three-amino-acid Brassica elicitor peptide that triggers the plant's own salt-tolerance programme through PEPR1, which is amplification rather than substitution. All three are small secreted proteins, and that is what lets one 0.2 micrometre membrane be both the containment and the delivery path.
questions.a_zh: 三種不同的機制，所以其中一個失敗不等於整個想法失敗。ACC 去胺酶是真正的催化劑：它在 ACC 氧化酶把 ACC 轉成乙烯之前就先把 ACC 分解掉，一個分子可以做很多次反應，這也是為什麼 wiki 上每一個實驗結果都是用它做的。LEA14 是化學計量型的，是一個內在無序的 hydrophilin，在脫水過程中保護膜和蛋白，所以能動的只有「更多份」或「每一份做更多事」；BoPep4 是 23 個胺基酸的 Brassica elicitor peptide，透過 PEPR1 啟動植物自己的耐鹽程式，是放大而不是替代。三個都是小的分泌型蛋白，這正是為什麼一層 0.2 微米的膜可以同時是圍阻和輸送路徑。
questions.trap_en: Presenting the three as equally evidenced. ACC deaminase has reactor data; BoPep4 has one hydroponic working dilution at 1/40; LEA14 has one agar set where 75 millimolar was best. Say which is which.
questions.trap_zh: 把三個講得證據一樣強。ACC 去胺酶有反應器數據；BoPep4 只有一個水耕工作稀釋 1/40；LEA14 只有一組 agar，75 mM 表現最好。要說清楚哪個是哪個。
questions.basis: instructor's priority set, 30 Oct read-through of Results, Hardware and Plants

questions.q_en: You used codon optimisation to make protectant synthesis more efficient. What did you observe in your results, and what do you conclude?
questions.q_zh: 你們用了密碼子優化來讓保護蛋白合成更有效率。結果觀察到什麼，結論是什麼？
kw_en: per OD600 it went the wrong way
kw_zh: 除以 OD600 後方向是反的
questions.a_en: For ACC deaminase, per OD600 it went the wrong way: wild-type Csn-ACCD read about 1.45 times the optimised arm, 29.9 against 19.5 at eight hours and 21.2 against 15.5 at twelve. For BoPep4 it went our way, with both optimised variants above wild type at twelve hours, 6.3 and 5.4 against 4.7 micrograms per millilitre. The comparison is confounded and we say so: our two ACC deaminase constructs differ in codon usage and in signal peptide, Csn against SamyQ, and the only thing that flips the direction is a 2.66-fold correction taken from published secretion efficiencies for other cargoes, which is not our measurement. So codon optimisation is not demonstrated to raise yield here; the optimised construct was kept for a practical reason, that the wild-type strain could not be recovered from glycerol stock, and the experiment owed is the matched pair, one signal peptide and both codon versions.
questions.a_zh: ACC 去胺酶這邊，除以 OD600 之後方向是反的：野生型 Csn-ACCD 大約是優化版的 1.45 倍，8 小時 29.9 對 19.5，12 小時 21.2 對 15.5。BoPep4 這邊方向是對我們有利的，兩個優化版在 12 小時都高於野生型，6.3 和 5.4 對 4.7 微克每毫升。這個比較被confound了，我們也寫出來：兩個 ACC 去胺酶構築同時換了密碼子和訊號肽（Csn 對 SamyQ），而唯一能把方向翻過來的是一個 2.66 倍的修正，那是從別的蛋白的文獻分泌效率推來的，不是我們量的。所以密碼子優化在這裡沒有被證明能提高產量；留下優化版是務實理由——野生型菌株無法從甘油保存液救回來——而該補的實驗是對照組：同一個訊號肽、兩種密碼子版本。
questions.trap_en: Saying codon optimisation worked. Per OD600 it is 1.45-fold the other way for ACC deaminase, and the 2.66 correction is literature, not data.
questions.trap_zh: 說密碼子優化有效。ACC 去胺酶除以 OD600 後是反方向的 1.45 倍，而 2.66 的修正是文獻值不是我們的數據。
questions.basis: instructor's priority set, 30 Oct read-through of Results, Hardware and Plants

questions.q_en: SamyQ with PLP gives 2.19 times the net product of Csn with PLP. Is that secretion, expression, or folding?
questions.q_zh: SamyQ 加 PLP 的淨產物是 Csn 加 PLP 的 2.19 倍。這是分泌、表現，還是折疊的差別？
questions.a_en: This experiment cannot tell them apart, and I would rather say that than pick one. What we measured is activity in the culture supernatant — 89.7 nanomoles of total product for SamyQ with PLP against the Csn with PLP arm — so the number is everything that happened upstream of the medium rolled into one: how much was transcribed and translated, how much crossed the membrane, and how much of what crossed folded into an active multimer. Separating them means assaying the cell-associated fraction and the total alongside the supernatant on the same culture, which we did not do. Until then SamyQ is the better signal peptide for this cargo in our hands, and that is the whole claim.
questions.a_zh: 這個實驗分不出來，我寧願這樣講，而不是挑一個講。我們量的是培養上清的活性——SamyQ 加 PLP 的總產物是 89.7 奈莫耳，高於 Csn 加 PLP 那一組——所以這個數字把進入培養液之前發生的所有事情全部壓在一起：轉錄轉譯了多少、有多少穿過膜、穿過去的裡面有多少折成有活性的多聚體。要分開就得在同一批培養裡同時測細胞結合的那一份和總量，這件事我們沒做。在那之前，我們能講的就只有「在我們手上，對這個蛋白來說 SamyQ 是比較好的訊號肽」。
questions.trap_en: Answering secretion with confidence. Only the supernatant was assayed, so expression and folding are inside the same number.
questions.trap_zh: 很有自信地回答「是分泌」。只量了上清，所以表現和折疊都還混在同一個數字裡。

questions.q_en: Your short-term ELISA baseline before any light is already 3.0 micrograms per millilitre against 1.3 for the plasmid-free control. So the circuit leaks in the dark. How much, and does it matter on a farm?
questions.q_zh: 你們短期實驗在還沒照光前，ELISA 基線就已經是 3.0 微克每毫升，而無質體對照是 1.3。所以這個線路在黑暗中就會漏表現。漏多少？在田裡會有影響嗎？
questions.a_en: Yes, there is signal before the light goes on: about 3.0 micrograms per millilitre at baseline against about 1.3 for the plasmid-free control, so roughly twice the host background with no illumination. We read that as the off state not being clean rather than as production, and the hardware gives a reason: CcaSR needs about 672 nanometres to switch off and our red LEDs emit at 640, so the cultures were never driven to a true off in any of these runs. On a farm it matters as wasted chassis resource and as protectant made when no stress has been forecast, which is the thing the architecture exists to avoid. Since the freeze we have built a 670 nanometre plate precisely to measure the dark state against a real off, and until that run exists the size of the leak is not something we can quote.
questions.a_zh: 是，照光之前就有訊號：基線大約 3.0 微克每毫升，無質體對照大約 1.3，所以在完全沒照光的情況下大約是宿主背景的兩倍。我們把這個讀成「off 狀態不乾淨」而不是「有在生產」，而硬體給了理由：CcaSR 需要大約 672 奈米才關得掉，我們的紅光 LED 是 640 奈米，所以這幾次實驗從來沒有把培養推到真正的 off。在田裡這代表兩件事：底盤資源的浪費，以及在沒有預測到逆境時仍然在做保護蛋白——而那正是整個架構要避免的事。凍結之後我們做了 670 奈米的板子，就是為了拿真正的 off 來量這個暗態；在那次實驗跑出來之前，漏多少我們沒辦法報一個數字。
questions.trap_en: Calling the baseline noise. It is twice the plasmid-free control on the same plate, so it is signal; the honest frame is an unclean off state we have not yet measured properly.
questions.trap_zh: 把基線講成雜訊。它是同一塊盤上無質體對照的兩倍，所以那是訊號；誠實的框架是「off 狀態不乾淨，而我們還沒有好好量過」。

questions.q_en: Your light-plate data is n = 2 with no statistics. What is the smallest experiment that would let you say green controls ACC deaminase and mean it?
questions.q_zh: 你們光板的數據是 n = 2 而且沒有統計。最小需要什麼實驗，才能真的講「綠光控制 ACC 去胺酶」？
questions.a_en: Three biological replicates per arm, a true off state, and a primary endpoint named before the run. The off state is the part people forget: our red LEDs are at 640 nanometres and CcaSR needs about 672, so the comparison has to be green against the 670 nanometre plate we built after the freeze, not green against our old red. The plate also needs a plasmid-free WB800 lane and a loading control, because the blots we have carry neither, and the endpoint has to be fixed in advance — activity by DNPH, with ELISA as the protein denominator — so that a green-high, red-low result at one time point cannot be chosen after the fact. That is about one week of plate work, and it is the single experiment that converts our strongest claim from partial to shown.
questions.a_zh: 每組三個生物重複、一個真正的 off 狀態，以及在實驗開始前就指定好的主要指標。off 狀態是大家最容易忘的部分：我們的紅光是 640 奈米，而 CcaSR 需要大約 672，所以比較必須是綠光對上凍結之後做的那塊 670 奈米板子，不是綠光對上我們舊的紅光。那塊板子還需要一個無質體的 WB800 lane 和一個 loading control，因為我們現有的 blot 兩個都沒有；指標也要事先定好——用 DNPH 的活性當主要指標、ELISA 當蛋白的分母——這樣就不會事後挑一個綠高紅低的時間點來講。這大約是一週的板子工作，而它是唯一能把我們最強的主張從 partial 變成 shown 的實驗。
questions.trap_en: Answering with more repeats alone. Without a 670 nanometre off state the extra replicates just measure the same unclean comparison more precisely.
questions.trap_zh: 只回答「多做幾次重複」。沒有 670 奈米的 off 狀態，多做重複只是把同一個不乾淨的比較量得更精準而已。
